description: Searches up to the latest 100 World Health Organization Disease Outbreak News reports for a country in the past 12 months, and discloses when the available reports cover a shorter period. For a US state, returns the latest available dated CDC figures: the state's acute respiratory illness level, wastewater levels for COVID, flu A and RSV at a typical site with the direction over three weeks (and the sites serving a county when one is given), and whether measles or H5 bird flu was found in the state's wastewater in the last four weeks. Inputs are a US state and an optional county, or a country. Applies to questions about current illness levels in a US state or reported outbreaks in a country. These are community levels, not a person's risk. Not medical advice. Travel-health notices for a destination are not in this result.

country.description: Any other country, for WHO outbreak reports; leave out for the US

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'WA'
